decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The hereby approved development shall cease on or before three years from the date of this approval, where after the use shall be reverted back to its current lawful use under Use Class A5.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Noise Impact Assessment Report 24309/NIA2 Rev2 dated 27th October 2017, Design and Access Statement, 0100, 3912-1, 3912-2, 0300 rev A, 0302, 0301, 0200, PL_1000 rev A, PL_3000, PL_3002, PL_3001, PL_2000 and Planning Statement and Retail assessment. Received: 27th October 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modifications) no use (including any other use within Use Class D1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended)) other than the hereby approved use as a Community Centre (Use Class D1) shall be carried out within the premises for the duration of the temporary planning permission hereby granted.

Condition : 5 - The cycle parking spaces as shown on plan Pl_1000 A received on the 27th October 2017 shall be implemented and made available for use prior to the commencement of the hereby approved use. There shall also be a minimum of a 1m gap between the Sheffield stands. Thereafter cycle parking shall be retained as such.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for Community Centre purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 09:00- 18:00 Monday to Saturday and 10:00 - 16:00 on Sundays and bank holidays.

Condition : 7 - Prior to first use of the premises as a Community Centre the flue on the flank wall of the building shall have been removed in its entirety and the parts removed from the site.   Thereafter the wall shall be made good to match.
description: Temporary permission for the change of use from hot food takeaway (Use class A5) to a community centre (Use class D1) including removal of extractor flue and reinstatement of flank elevation window to ground floor.
